name: 李建樂
objective:
本課程旨在介紹智慧醫療領域中常見之生醫大數據分析技術與應用，培養學生運用資訊科技解決醫療與生命科學問題之能力。課程內容涵蓋基礎生物學概念、生物資訊的經典演算法、基因體學與轉錄體學資料分析流程，以及微陣列（Microarray）、次世代定序（Next-Generation Sequencing, NGS）等高通量生物技術。學生將學習 DNA 定序分析、RNA 定序分析及總體基因體（Metagenomics）分析方法，並透過實作熟悉生醫大數據分析流程。此外，課程邀請生醫領域專家進行專題演講，介紹電子病歷（Electronic Health Records, EHR）、基因體學（Genomics）、代謝體學（Metabolomics）等智慧醫療大數據之實務應用與發展趨勢。透過案例分析與閱讀期刊討論，培養學生整合生醫資料與人工智慧技術之能力。
This course provides a comprehensive introduction to biomedical big data analytics and its applications in smart healthcare. Topics include fundamental biological concepts, classical bioinformatics algorithms, genomic and transcriptomic data analysis, and high-throughput technologies such as Microarray and Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS). Students will learn the principles and practical workflows of DNA-seq, RNA-seq, and metagenomic analyses through hands-on exercises and real-world datasets.
The course also features invited lectures from biomedical experts covering emerging applications of healthcare big data, including Electronic Health Records (EHRs), Genomics, Metabolomics, and other multi-omics data. Through case studies, journal paper discussions, and practical projects, students will gain experience in integrating biomedical data analytics with artificial intelligence techniques to address challenges in healthcare, precision medicine, and biomedical research.
課程進度(1-16週):
Week 1: Introduction
Week 2-3: Concept of biology
Week 4: NO CLASS (Teachers' Day)
Week 5: Concept of biology
Week 6: Special lecture
Week 7: Sequencing alignment & Microarray technologies
Week 8: NO CLASS (Taiwan Retrocession Day)
Week 9: Introduction of sequencing technologies
Week 10-11: DNA-seq analysis
Week 12-13: RNA-seq analysis
Week 14-15: Metagenomic analysis
Week 16-17: Special lectures
Week 18: Final report
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 學生分組實作及討論 (Student group practice and discussion)
● 遠距教學 (Distance learning)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          (1) 第 17 週：邀請專家學者進行遠距教學，講授與智慧醫療相關臨床應用，每位學生於課後提出一份心得報告。(Week 17: Invite experts or scholars to conduct remote lecture on clinical applications related to smart healthcare. Each student is required to submit a reflection report after class.)
(2) 第 18 週：各組選定一篇與課程相關之近期研究期刊進行報告分享，全班參與 Q & A 提問討論。(Week 18: Each group selects a recent research article related to the course for a presentation and sharing session. The entire class participates in a Q & A discussion.)
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          6
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          (1) 第 17 週：上課後每位學生需繳交心得報告一份。(Week 17: Each student is required to submit a reflection report after class.)
(2) 第 18 週：上課前需繳交 PPT 簡報檔。(Week 18: The PowerPoint presentation file must be submitted before class.)
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          (1) 心得報告：10% (Reflection report: 10%)
(2) 口頭報告與 PPT 簡報：30% (Oral presentation and PPT presentation file: 30%)

materials:
1. Campbell Biology 12/e, Lisa U. et al., Pearson.
2. Concepts of Biology, Samantha Fowler et al., OpenStax.
3. Biology (2/e), Mary A. Clark et al., OpenStax.
4. Bioinformatics: A Practical Guide to Next Generation Sequencing Data Analysis, Hamid D. Ismail, CRC Press.
5. Bioinformatics: A Practical Guide to NCBI Databases and Sequence Alignments, Hamid D. Ismail, CRC Press.
6. 生物人的電腦教室, 李鎮宇 (Eric Lee), 碁峰資訊
7. Developing Bioinformatics Computer Skills, Per Jambeck & Cynthia Gibas, O'Reilly.
